v0.1.0 is the first stable release of token-usage. It finalizes the feature set shipped across v0.1.0-rc.1 … rc.13 — since rc.13 the only changes are documentation, installer defaults, and CLI help-text examples (no runtime behavior changes), so rc users can update in place with `token-usage update`. From this release on, the GitHub `/releases/latest` link resolves again (a stable release now exists).

### Highlights
- Message/API-request-level token accounting across AI clients: Claude Code/Desktop, OpenCode, Codex, WorkBuddy, ZCode, and Zhipu-AutoClaw
- Accurate attribution across dates, models, sessions, forks, and rewind operations
- Codex rollout replay deduplication — rate-limit bucket replays are not double-counted
- CC Switch router attribution backfill (currently effective for the Claude family)
- Two run modes: one-off CLI commands and a real-time monitoring daemon with startup catch-up
- Autostart via macOS launchd and the Windows Registry Run key
- In-place self-update from official GitHub Releases (SHA256-verified, per-run upgrade log, interrupted-update recovery)
- Single pure-Go binary (no CGO), supporting macOS (Apple Silicon/Intel) and Windows

### Changed
- The installer scripts now resolve the latest **stable** release by default (`/releases/latest`) and install a prerelease only when its tag is passed explicitly (`TAG=vX.Y.Z-rc.N` / `-Tag vX.Y.Z-rc.N`)

### Installation
See the [README Quick Start](https://github.com/YuLaiZ/token-usage#quick-start) — one command on macOS, two commands on Windows, or paste the AI-agent instruction to your assistant; the full manual-install / uninstall / migration guide lives under `docs/` in the repo.

### Fixed during the RC cycle
- Windows: SQLite initialization on drive-letter paths (`file:///C:/...` normalization)
- Windows self-update: staged downloads get a `.exe` extension and file names that avoid the word "update" (blocked by Windows security policy); failed version probes clean up the stage file
- Update download timeout raised from 30 seconds to 20 minutes for slow networks and proxied machines
- Per-run upgrade log at `~/.token-usage/logs/update-YYYY-MM-DD.log`, with stale-file cleanup (dead-letter consumption, nonce sweep, stage removal)

<!-- zh -->
v0.1.0 是 token-usage 的首个稳定版，汇总定稿 v0.1.0-rc.1 … rc.13 交付的全部能力——自 rc.13 起仅变更文档、安装脚本默认行为与 CLI 帮助文本示例（无运行时行为变化），rc 用户可用 `token-usage update` 原地升级。自本版起 GitHub `/releases/latest` 链接恢复可用（已存在稳定版）。

### 亮点
- 面向多 AI 客户端（Claude Code/Desktop、OpenCode、Codex、WorkBuddy、ZCode、Zhipu-AutoClaw）的消息/API 请求级 token 记账
- 跨日期、模型、会话、分支与 rewind 操作的精确归属
- Codex rollout 重放去重——速率限制桶变化导致的重放不重复计数
- CC Switch 路由归属回填（当前仅对 Claude 家族生效）
- 两种运行模式：一次性 CLI 命令与带启动补采的实时监控守护进程
- 通过 macOS launchd 与 Windows 注册表 Run 键实现开机自启
- 从官方 GitHub Release 原地自更新（SHA256 校验、逐次升级日志、中断更新恢复）
- 纯 Go 单二进制（无 CGO），支持 macOS（Apple 芯片/Intel）与 Windows

### 变更
- 安装脚本默认解析最新**稳定版** Release（`/releases/latest`），仅显式传入 tag（`TAG=vX.Y.Z-rc.N` / `-Tag vX.Y.Z-rc.N`）时才安装预发布版

### 安装
见 [README 快速开始](https://github.com/YuLaiZ/token-usage/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md#快速开始)——macOS 一条命令、Windows 两条命令，或把「复制给 AI Agent」的指令交给你的助手；完整的手动安装 / 卸载 / 迁移指南在仓库 `docs/` 目录下。

### RC 周期内的关键修复
- Windows：盘符路径的 SQLite 初始化（规范化为 `file:///C:/...` 形式）
- Windows 自更新：stage 下载补 `.exe` 扩展名、文件名避开 "update" 字样（Windows 安全策略拦截）；版本探针失败时清理 stage 文件
- 更新下载超时从 30 秒提高到 20 分钟，覆盖慢网络与代理环境
- 逐次升级日志 `~/.token-usage/logs/update-YYYY-MM-DD.log`，含残留文件清理（死信消费、nonce 清扫、stage 移除）
